entities.name: Nymph
entities.description: Divine spirits who animate nature; on Theros created by the gods as companions, messengers, guardians or scouts.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane where nymphs were created by the gods.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: Night-sky realm of the gods, native to nymphs.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: Goddess of the Hunt to whom nymphs pay homage.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God whom lampads help guide the dead.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God fond of the company of oreads.

entities.name: Naiads
entities.description: Blue-aligned water nymphs of the Nistos Forest.

entities.name: Lampads
entities.description: Black-aligned underworld nymphs who help Athreos.

entities.name: Dryads
entities.description: Green-aligned plant nymphs and Nylea's followers.

events.summary: On Theros, nymphs are intentionally created by the gods as servants.
events.quote: nymphs were intentionally created by the gods

relations.quote: help Athreos in guiding the dead
